train_GRPOTrainer: train a language model using the GSPO-token GRPOTrainer with importance sampling and entropy regularization
compute_GRPO_loss: compute the GSPO-token per-token loss with sequence-level importance sampling and entropy masking
build_GRPO_inputs: build the inputs dictionary with prompt_ids, completion_ids, advantages, and reference log probabilities for GRPO training
configure_importance_sampling: configure the importance sampling level as token, sequence, or sequence_token for GSPO-token gradient estimation
log_GRPO_metrics: log GRPO training metrics including KL divergence, entropy, and clipped probability ratio statistics
